title: 第11章 修炼兵伐诀，君战天道心快崩了
content_zh:
君仗剑脸色一阵青一阵红。
刚才还想着出手不能太重，若是伤到君逍遥就不好了。
现在倒好，自己满身尘土，浑身是伤。
“逍遥族弟果然有神人之姿啊，族兄佩服……”君仗剑起身，脸上勉强挤出一个比哭还难看的笑容。
今日他的脸面，算是丢光了。
君逍遥一战斗起来，简直火力全开，甚至他连不灭剑体都来不及施展。
不过即便能够施展不灭剑体，君仗剑也没有把握能镇住君逍遥。
因为君逍遥出生时，可是拥有万圣朝拜异象。
圣体异象一出，谁人可敌？
“真是个怪物……”君仗剑心里暗自叹道。
才三岁就有这般实力，再过几年，那还了得，怕是可以挑战前五的序列了。
四周众人也是吃惊地合不拢嘴，想必要不了多久，这一次战斗的消息就会传遍整个君家。
君逍遥才在泰岳古碑打破万古极境，现在又打败了君仗剑。
少部分之前还对君逍遥心有质疑的族人，现在也是佩服地五体投地。
“逍遥族弟日后前途无量，等到你十岁之后，定然可以成为序列，甚至在我之上。”君仗剑说道。
君家的规矩，年轻一辈在十岁后，才有资格加入序列的争夺。
君逍遥却是耸了耸肩。
他早就已经是十八祖内定的零号序列。
身份地位甚至在第一序列之上。
只是暂时还没有公布而已。

等到十岁宴上就会公布，到时候君仗剑若知道这个消息，还不知会是什么表情呢。
“逍遥族弟，再会。”君仗剑现在只想闭关修炼。
君逍遥则淡淡说道：“对了，仗剑族兄，你身为序列，没必要让什么阿猫阿狗都当追随者，那样有失身份。”
君仗剑闻言，目光一闪，开口道：“知晓了。”
而听到这话的兰清雅，脸色却是无比臊红，心中屈辱异常。
显然，君逍遥口中的阿猫阿狗，就是指她。
随后，君仗剑和兰清雅两人离去。
“哎，我的手段还是不足啊……”君逍遥目露思索之色。
他现在虽是打基础的阶段，但也该修炼一些武学神通了。
不然的话，手段太过单一。
君家身为荒古世家，最不缺的就是各种稀有武学典籍。
“去找爷爷问问。”君逍遥暗想。
而另一边，君仗剑没走出多远，就停下了脚步。
“看来往日情面上，你离开君家吧。”君仗剑漠然道。
“不，仗剑公子，别赶清雅走！”兰清雅脸色骤变，煞白无比。
在君家，任何修炼资源，她都唾手可得，地位也是高人一等。
若是离开君家，她将同那些在底层挣扎的女修没什么两样。
“滚吧，若不是你，我怎会惹上这样的麻烦，还丢了这么大的脸！”
君仗剑手臂一甩，将兰清雅震飞，令其口吐鲜血。
看着君仗剑漠然离去的背影，兰清雅脸上的痛苦，转变为了刻骨的怨毒之意。

“君逍遥，都是你，仗着身份，欺压他人……”
“荒古圣体，难道是打破了一道枷锁的荒古圣体，若是把这个消息告诉那些君家的敌对势力，或是太古皇族……”
兰清雅脸色变幻，心中猜测。
以她有限的想象力，根本无法想象君逍遥是打破了十道枷锁的荒古圣体。
在她看来，打破了一道枷锁的荒古圣体，都非常少见。
“对了，听闻这君逍遥日后将举办十岁宴，到时候，若引敌人前来……”
兰清雅自知，以她自己的能力，别说这辈子，就算下辈子，下下辈子，也绝对报复不了君逍遥。
唯一的办法，就是借刀杀人。
“等着吧，君逍遥，还有君玲珑这个贱人，你们都会付出代价的！”
兰清雅披头散发，灰头土脸，最后被君家护卫押走，扫地出门。
而另一边，君逍遥则压根没有在意兰清雅这个小人物。
她在君逍遥眼中，甚至连蚂蚁都不如。
之所以那样告诫君仗剑，只是不想以后看到碍眼而已。
此刻，君逍遥正在向君战天请教。
“什么，你要学武学神通，这未免太过好高骛远……”君战天皱着花白的眉毛。
在他看来，君逍遥未免太过躁进了。
才三岁而已，正是打基础的时候，学什么武学神通。
而且修炼武学神通也是需要天资悟性的，还要消耗大量时间。
“让我试一试，若是耗费时间太多，大不了不学。”君逍遥道。
最后君战天拗不过，只能答应先让君逍遥修炼一种武学神通。

而且君战天还卖弄了一个小心思，他特意挑选了君家一门威力极大，等级颇高，但也非常复杂的攻伐神通。
“此乃兵伐诀，修炼大成后，法力可凝为刀，枪，剑，戟，斧，钺，钩，叉等等神兵，兵伐诀一出，万千神兵随行，斩天灭地，威力强绝。”君战天解释道。
“那好，我就修炼兵伐诀了。”君逍遥眸中有着兴奋。
君战天呵呵一笑，心里则是得意想道：“孙子，想跟爷爷斗还太嫩了点，这门神通，爷爷当年也是足足修炼了一年，才堪堪入门……”
在君战天预想中，君逍遥应该修炼几天之后，就会放弃了吧。
然而，短短数日时间过后。
天帝宫内，有轰鸣声震响，无尽金光暴涌苍穹。
金色的法力如同风暴一般席卷，随后凝结为刀枪剑戟等等神兵，劈天裂地而出。
“爷爷，都过了几天，我才堪堪入门，修炼神通果然很复杂。”君逍遥走出，微微摇头，一脸失望道。
“咳……”君战天一口老血差点没吐出来。
“爷爷？”君逍遥疑惑。
“没……没什么，以后想学什么神通，自己去武阁找，爷爷要去静一静。”
君战天转身即走，根本不想再跟这个小怪物多待一会儿。
因为再待下去，君战天怕是道心都要崩了，怀疑自己这么多年全活到狗身上去了！
君逍遥一脸摸不着头脑。
接下来，五年时间转瞬即逝。
这一年，君逍遥已经八岁了。
少年初长成，俊秀如仙人谪尘。
有时候君玲珑，都可以呆呆的盯着君逍遥神秀绝伦的俊颜看一整天，不会有丝毫的厌烦。
对任何一个女子来说，能每天看到这样一张谪仙般的俊颜，绝对是三辈子修不来的福分。

君逍遥自己，则是一直专注于修炼，没有懈怠。
他的功法乃是君家的至尊法，太玄经。
炼体法门是神象镇狱劲。
炼魂法门则是混沌神魔观想法。
此外，还有包括兵伐诀在内的一些君家武学神通，他也在修炼，可谓是齐头并进。
君逍遥的修为，也是直接连跨灵海九重天，破入了神宫境，和当初君仗剑的修为境界差不多。
而且因为荒古圣体的特殊原因，他体内丹田的灵海，乃是金色灵海，无边无际。
法力雄浑程度，同阶级无人能比，堪称无尽灵海。
“离十岁宴，仅有两年了，等十岁宴过后，我也该出门行走天下了，顺便探查一下元天至尊秘藏的消息。”君逍遥喃喃自语。
这两处签到地，他可是一直念念不忘。
毕竟已经签到了大成荒古圣体和神象镇狱劲，他很好奇接下来签到还能获得什么好东西。
而另一边，君玲珑也在天帝宫的一侧偏殿修炼，她已经完完全全成为了君逍遥的忠诚侍女。
某一刻，君玲珑心有所感，拿出一枚传递消息的玉简，里面有消息传出。
“是她？”君玲珑美目一敛。
content_en:
Jun Zhanjian's face turned green and red.
Just now I was thinking that I shouldn't hit too hard, otherwise it would be bad if I hurt Jun Xiaoyao.
It's better now, I'm covered in dust and bruises.
"Brother Xiaoyao really has the appearance of a god. Brother, I admire you..." Jun stood up with his sword and forced a smile that was uglier than crying.
Today, he has lost all face.
As soon as Jun Xiaoyao started fighting, he was so full of fire that he couldn't even use the Immortal Sword.
However, even if he could use the Immortal Sword Body, Jun Zhanjian was not sure that he could suppress Jun Xiaoyao.
Because when Jun Xiaoyao was born, he had the vision of worshiping all saints.
Once the vision of the Eucharist appears, who can resist it?
"What a monster..." Jun Zhanjian sighed to himself.
He has such strength at the age of three. In a few years, it will be great, and he may be able to challenge the top five.
Everyone around them was also shocked and grinning from ear to ear, thinking that it wouldn't be long before the news of this battle would spread throughout the Jun family.
Jun Xiaoyao had just broken through the Eternal Realm at the Taiyue Ancient Monument, and now he defeated Jun Zhanjian again.
A small number of tribesmen who had doubts about Jun Xiaoyao before were now in admiration.
"Brother Xiaoyao has a bright future. When you are ten years old, you will definitely become a ranker, even above me." Jun Zhanjian said.
According to the rules of the Jun family, the younger generation is only eligible to participate in the competition after they are ten years old.
Jun Xiaoyao shrugged.
He has long been the number zero assigned by the Eighteenth Patriarch.
The status is even higher than the first sequence.
It’s just that it hasn’t been announced yet.
It will be announced at the tenth-year-old banquet. If Jun Zhanjian knows the news, I don't know what his expression will be.
"Goodbye, Xiaoyao clan brother." Jun Zhanjian just wants to practice in seclusion now.
Jun Xiaoyao said calmly: "By the way, Brother Zhanjian Clan, as a member of the Sequence, there is no need for all cats and dogs to be your followers. That would be disrespectful to you."
When Jun Zhanjian heard this, his eyes flashed and he said, "I understand."
When Lan Qingya heard this, her face turned extremely red, and she felt extremely humiliated in her heart.
Obviously, the cats and dogs in Jun Xiaoyao's words refer to her.
Afterwards, Jun Zhanjian and Lan Qingya left.
"Hey, my methods are still not enough..." Jun Xiaoyao looked thoughtful.
Although he is now at the stage of laying the foundation, it is time for him to practice some magical powers in martial arts.
Otherwise, the method is too simple.
As an ancient family, the Jun family is most indispensable for all kinds of rare martial arts books.
"Go and ask Grandpa." Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
On the other side, Jun Zhanjian stopped before he had gone far.
"It seems that for the sake of old love, you should leave the Jun family." Jun Zhanjian said indifferently.
"No, Master Zhanjian, don't drive Qingya away!" Lan Qingya's face suddenly changed and turned extremely pale.
In the Jun family, she has all the cultivation resources at her fingertips, and her status is superior to others.
If she leaves the Jun family, she will be no different from those female cultivators struggling at the bottom.
"Go away, if it weren't for you, how could I have gotten into such trouble and lost such a big face!"
Jun Zhanjian flicked his arm, knocking Lan Qingya away, causing her to vomit blood.
Seeing Jun Zhanjian's back leaving indifferently, the pain on Lan Qingya's face turned into deep-seated resentment.
"Jun Xiaoyao, it's you who bullies others based on your status..."
"Could the Ancient Holy Body be the Ancient Holy Body that broke a shackle? If this news is told to the hostile forces of the Jun family, or to the ancient royal family..."
Lan Qingya's expression changed, and she was guessing.
With her limited imagination, she simply could not imagine that Jun Xiaoyao was an ancient holy body that had broken ten shackles.
In her opinion, it is very rare for an ancient holy body to break a shackle.
"By the way, I heard that Jun Xiaoyao will hold a ten-year-old banquet in the future. If the enemy is attracted by then..."
Lan Qingya knew that with her ownAbility, let alone this life, even in the next life, I will never be able to take revenge on Jun Xiaoyao.
The only way is to kill with a borrowed knife.
"Wait, Jun Xiaoyao, and this bitch Jun Linglong, you will all pay the price!"
Lan Qingya, with disheveled hair and a gray face, was finally escorted away by the Jun family's guards and kicked out.
On the other side, Jun Xiaoyao didn't care about this little person like Lan Qingya at all.
In Jun Xiaoyao's eyes, she was even worse than an ant.
The reason why I warned Jun Zhanjian like that was because I didn't want to be an eyesore in the future.
At this moment, Jun Xiaoyao was asking Jun Zhantian for advice.
"What, you want to learn martial arts and magical powers? This is too ambitious..." Jun Zhantian frowned with gray eyebrows.
In his opinion, Jun Xiaoyao was too aggressive.
He is only three years old, and it is the time to lay the foundation for learning martial arts and magical powers.
Moreover, practicing martial arts requires talent and understanding, and it also consumes a lot of time.
"Let me give it a try. If it takes too much time, I might as well not learn." Jun Xiaoyao said.
In the end, Jun Zhantian couldn't resist and could only agree to let Jun Xiaoyao practice a martial arts magical power first.
Moreover, Jun Zhantian also showed off a little trick. He specially selected an extremely powerful, high-level, but also very complex offensive magical power from the Jun family.
"This is the Military Conquest Technique. After you have mastered it, your magic power can be condensed into knives, spears, swords, halberds, axes, axes, hooks, forks and other divine weapons. Once the Military Conquest Technique is released, thousands of divine soldiers will accompany you, killing the heavens and the earth. It is extremely powerful." Jun Zhantian explained.
"Okay then, I will practice the art of military attack." Jun Xiaoyao's eyes were filled with excitement.
Jun Zhantian chuckled, and thought proudly in his heart: "Grandson, you are still too young to fight with grandpa. Grandpa also practiced this magical power for a full year before he was able to get started..."
In Jun Zhantian's expectation, Jun Xiaoyao would give up after practicing for a few days.
However, after just a few days.
In the Emperor's Palace, there was a roar, and endless golden light burst into the sky.
The golden mana swept across like a storm, and then condensed into weapons such as swords, spears, swords, and halberds, splitting the sky and splitting the earth.
"Grandpa, it's been a few days before I can get started. Practicing magical powers is indeed very complicated." Jun Xiaoyao walked out, shaking his head slightly, with a look of disappointment on his face.
"Ahem..." Jun Zhantian almost spit out a mouthful of old blood.
"Grandpa?" Jun Xiaoyao was confused.
"No...it's nothing. If you want to learn any magical powers in the future, you can go to the martial arts pavilion to find them yourself. Grandpa needs to go and have some quiet time."
Jun Zhantian turned around and left, not wanting to stay with this little monster any longer.
Because if he stays any longer, Jun Zhantian is afraid that his Taoist heart will collapse, and he suspects that he has lived like a dog for so many years!
Jun Xiaoyao looked confused.
The next five years flew by in a blink of an eye.
This year, Jun Xiaoyao is eight years old.
The boy has grown up and is as handsome as an immortal banished to the dust.
Sometimes Jun Linglong could just stare at Jun Xiaoyao's stunningly handsome face for the whole day without feeling bored at all.
For any woman, being able to see such an immortal face every day is definitely a blessing that cannot be obtained in three lifetimes.
Jun Xiaoyao himself has been focusing on his cultivation without slacking off.
His technique is the supreme method of the Jun family, the Taixuan Jing.
The body refining method is the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power.
The soul refining method is based on the concept of chaos gods and demons.
In addition, there are some martial arts magical powers of the Jun family, including the art of military attack, which he is also practicing, and they can be said to be progressing hand in hand.
Jun Xiaoyao's cultivation level also directly crossed the ninth level of the spiritual sea and broke into the divine palace realm, which was similar to the original cultivation level of Jun Zhanjian.
And because of the special reason of the Ancient Holy Body, the spiritual sea in his Dantian is a golden spiritual sea, boundless.
The level of magical power is unmatched by anyone in the same class, and it can be called an endless spiritual sea.
"There are only two years until the ten-year-old banquet. After the ten-year-old banquet is over, it will be time for me to go out and travel around the world. By the way,Let’s explore the news about Yuantian Supreme’s secret treasure. "Jun Xiaoyao murmured to himself.
He has never forgotten these two check-in places.
After all, he had already signed up for the Dacheng Ancient Holy Body and Divine Elephant Prison Suppressing Power, and he was curious about what good things he could get by signing up next.
On the other side, Jun Linglong is also practicing in a side hall of the Emperor's Palace. She has completely become Jun Xiaoyao's loyal maid.
At a certain moment, Jun Linglong felt something in her heart and took out a jade slip to convey news, and there was news in it.
"Is it her? "Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes narrowed.
